# @amykit/plugin-plan-check

The quality bar for a drafted plan: the repository's own check, run in its checkout.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `plan-check` port.

Use it with note-to-plan, which checks every plan it drafts before proposing it. It mounts the plan-check port and the check-plan action, and runs the repository's own check commands in the plan's checkout, so a plan only goes forward once the repository's own bar passes.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | `plan-check` |
| Actions | `check-plan` |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-plan-check
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-plan-check"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-plan-check":
    baseBranch: {}
    commands: {"default":["sf check"]}
    defaultBranch: "main"
    timeoutMs: 600000
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `baseBranch` | `record` | no | `{}` | where one repository's base branch is, instead of the fallback. A repository named here has its work cut from, and its pull requests opened against, that branch |
| `commands` | `record` | no | `{"default":["sf check"]}` | the check commands per repository, with a `default` fallback. `sf check` is the whole quality bar in a repository that has one |
| `defaultBranch` | `string` | no | `main` | the branch new work is cut from, for a repository that named none, which is not always `main` |
| `timeoutMs` | `number` | no | `600000` | how long one check may run before it is given up on |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
